title: AbortController against the mock

blocks.promptMd: A fetch aborted via `signal` rejects with…
A fetch aborted via `signal` rejects as a 404 response.
blocks.explainMd: Abort rejects the fetch with an error named AbortError. It is not a 404 slip.

blocks.promptMd: > Start `/slow` with an `AbortController` `signal`, abort, print `aborted`. Do not hard-code `return "aborted"` without the controller.

hintLadder.md: Make an `AbortController` and pass `{ signal: c.signal }` to `fetch`.

description: Cancel a request on purpose when you have waited long enough.
